verdict.rationale: Hosted invoicing is a fair axis for a payments platform, but the evidence pack never documents Adyen invoices or automatic payment reminders. Payment links (adyen-docs-24, adyen-supp-mcp-tools) let customers pay online, but they are an adjacent feature: they are not invoice documents and come with no reminder scheduling, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders
